# Open AGI

> Open AGI builds AI systems that work with company data: executive reports, risk control, document review. Also smart devices and cybersecurity.

Canonical site: https://nurgisa-labs.github.io/Mini-AGI
Languages: Kazakh, Russian, and English
Last updated: 2026-11-25

## What we do

- AI for executives and teams: Executive reports from company data, project risk control, public tender matching, review of large document sets. AI prepares; a person checks and decides.
- Smart devices · in development: A device built for one task: electronics, firmware, a 3D-printed enclosure. We are now building a presence sensor without a camera.
- Cybersecurity · new area: We connect AI to company data safely: a separate account, read-only access, permission checks before launch.

## How to start

1. A conversation: what the task is and what depends on it.
2. A first result on your data.
3. We review the result and decide whether to continue.

AI prepares, people decide.
